acceptance_rules: The BSharp Bytecode golden parity harness tool must pass in the Trial-by-Fire validation inventory.
Every accepted fixture must produce the exact locked BSBC byte SHA256 digest.
Every accepted fixture must produce the exact locked bytecode loader summary digest.
Subset-emitted BSBC bytes must stay compatible with the existing bytecode loader.
The new parity harness must not become the production compiler path in this build.
No Profile 8, syntax, runtime, bytecode rename, web export, browser, engine bridge, or Ruby retirement work is allowed.
